body.interpretation: Non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the script-frame field at +0x20 (FFrame*): 0 stays 0, non-zero n becomes n+1. Then load the vtable pointer from [this] (RCX) and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the virtual function at vtable byte offset 0xdd0 (entry index 448). No other side effects, no return value. The reflected exec entry is only this frame side-effect plus the virtual dispatch; the real handler body lives in the vtable slot.
